name: Magic Seed
commentary:
Magic Seed creates up to 8 bench sprouts with `buy_price = 1`; if a sprout cannot be created, that slot is immediately paid out as 1 gold instead.

At the beginning of each round while Magic Seed is active and `relic_ttl <= 10`, each sprout independently has a `battle_round * 2 + 20` percent chance to gain +1 sell value. For example: round 5 is 30%, round 10 is 40%, round 20 is 60%, and round 40 is 100%. Selling a sprout pays its current `buy_price`.

source.name: Magic Seed
source.description: Fill your bench with magic vegetable sprouts. The sell value of these sprouts has a dynamic chance to increase by 1 at the beginning of every round. You can sell the sprouts any time to reuse the bench.
